description: Run an Analysis as its New Run page does. Local (this computer, free) by default; a cloud run is paid and needs the user's go-ahead, then confirm_cloud. Inputs by parameter name; omitted ones take their defaults. Returns the run id; with wait, blocks until it ends and returns its headline outputs.

confirm_cloud.description: Required true for a cloud run: the user agreed to pay.

model.description: Name or id. Default: the analysis's default model, else the open one.

solver.description: Default: the Solve step's (MOSEK when the plan has it).

name: run_analysis
